title: Puharich witnesses UFOs alongside Uri Geller

tellings.quote: Puharic himself witnessed UFOs in conjunction with Ariel as well as synchronicities

plain: In the 1970s, Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychic phenomena, is said to have seen UFOs himself while working with Uri Geller, the Israeli performer famous for claiming to bend spoons with his mind. A parapsychologist named Jeffrey Mishlove repeats this, saying Puharich also witnessed strange meaningful coincidences around Geller. If true, it would tie psychic powers and UFOs together in one person's direct experience.
